title: Guest Services Desk Note on Courtesy Minibar Removals across a Guest's Folios
content:
Courtesy removals of minibar lines on Guest Folios are combined across all of a guest's folios.

## The rule

1. **What a courtesy removal is.** A courtesy removal is a minibar line taken off with the reason that the charge was not incurred, on the guest's own statement that the item was not consumed, with no record contradicting it.
2. **When guest services may make one.** Guest services makes a courtesy removal only while both of these hold, each counted before the removal being considered:
   - the folio's courtesy removals are fewer than the brand's courtesy minibar removals per folio; and
   - the guest's courtesy removals across all of the guest's folios in the last 365 days are fewer than 2.
3. **Beyond either allowance.** A minibar dispute beyond either allowance is not removed by guest services and is referred to the hotel as a billing dispute.
4. **Brands with no allowance.** Brands whose courtesy minibar removals per folio is 0 grant no courtesy removals.

## How the two counts are taken

| Count | What is counted | Period |
|---|---|---|
| The folio's courtesy removals | Minibar lines on this folio already taken off with the reason that the charge was not incurred | The whole life of the folio up to the moment of handling |
| The guest's courtesy removals | Minibar lines taken off with the reason that the charge was not incurred on every folio of the same guest | The 365 calendar days ending on the handling date, inclusive, by the date each removal was posted |

Both counts rest on the folio records, not on the guest's account of past removals, and both are matched to the folio and the guest whose minibar line is in question.

## Decision table (hypothetical counts; brand allowance per folio of 1)

| Folio count before | Guest count before (365 days) | Removal by guest services |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0 | Made |
| 0 | 1 | Made |
| 0 | 2 | Not made; referred to the hotel as a billing dispute |
| 1 | 0 | Not made; referred to the hotel as a billing dispute |

With a brand allowance per folio of 2, a folio count of 1 still permits a removal if the guest count is below 2.
